sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: A selected older week can be outside the global 1000-row result and become a false healthy zero. An all_vehicles=false rule with multiple vehicle_ids leaves legacy vehicle_id=0, which the digest treats as global even for a vehicle outside that canonical scope.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Consider selected week absent from capped recent rows, or a returned multi-vehicle rule scoped to synthetic IDs 4/5 while selected ID is 6. The existing filter yields respectively zero or an incorrectly included alert. This is control-flow evidence, not a real-data observation.

Replace unconditional healthy-zero interpretation where coverage is unknown. No backend capability invention.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Absent SOC measurements in returned sessions become measured zero
evidence: useWeeklyDigest.ts:24-31 averagePresent returns 0 for no finite measurements
BatteryPanel.tsx:36 decides availability from session count
BatteryPanel.tsx:57,62,72 renders zero meters and charge gain
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: One returned session with both SOC fields null passes hasData and renders 0%/0%/0% gain. Independently missing end SOC can also generate a misleading negative gain from a measured start average. Source-level session availability does not establish each field's measurement.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace a single in-week charging session with null start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct through averagePresent, hasData and meter props; compare an actual numeric 0 session, which must remain valid.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue exact nullable-average view-model/panel handling with focused null/partial/measured-zero tests; retain charge count, energy, source retention and paused charging behavior.

evidence: DrivingPanel.tsx:59-98,145,161 details are independent of plot loading/error

useWeeklyDigest.ts:239-244 null energy is safeNumber zero
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Before a source has returned, zero-initialized aggregates are formatted into ready-looking footer values even while the plot is loading or fatal. After a payload returns, a null energy measurement is still zeroed. presentedMetric converts all specialist numeric measurements to text and therefore bypasses formatMetric's numeric/missing validation.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace no retained drive/charge payload plus isLoading=true into unconditional detail StatGroup; then trace a returned drive with energyUsedWh=null. This is not a new rendered test.

Preserve independently available detail/top-drive content and every accepted retained-source behavior; never gate the whole page or rewrite unrelated children.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Fun-fact multiplier reparses a localized display string as a number
evidence: formatMetric.ts:35-38 rejects nonfinite raw input before formatter
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Comma-decimal or grouped locale strings are not JavaScript numeric literals. For example the source can produce '1,40', whose Number conversion is NaN; the validated multiplier becomes unavailable even though its underlying numeric ratio is known.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Follow any non-integer city-distance ratio under a comma-decimal locale from fmtNumber into Number. No executed calculation/test is claimed.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue only raw numeric fun-fact multiplier propagation and its exact summary/type producers with focused locale cases. Keep existing formatted specialist label/context, city-pair logic and threshold.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Child localization contract is incomplete for data labels, dates and unit-bearing title keys
evidence: useWeeklyDigest.ts:320,331 carries those labels directly to charts
useWeeklyDigest.ts:75 and DrivingPanel.tsx:108 call dates without locale
dateFormat.ts:44-50,65-82 defaults absent locale to browser
DrivingPanel.tsx:140 and ChargingPanel.tsx:106 call unit-bearing title keys without unit
C10 canonical dailyDistance='Daily distance ({{unit}})' and dailyEnergyAdded='Daily energy added ({{unit}})'
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: Translated chrome surrounds English weekday/severity data; selected numeric locale is not passed to date labels. Canonical title keys require unit interpolation but the title call sites omit it, while subtitle/data-column calls supply it.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Trace a non-English UI/settings locale differing from the browser; inspect title translation arguments against the canonical leaf. Exact i18next warning/output under missing interpolation is NOTRUN.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue exact child label/date/unit-key call-site corrections, including canonical catalog integration only if genuinely needed and exclusively claimed. Preserve raw severity/weekday identities, ordering, chart values and physical units.

sourceConfirmedFindings.title: Flat week-over-week change is forced into favorable green
evidence: DigestTrend.tsx:30-37 tests positive before flat neutral branch
sourceConfirmedFindings.mechanism: For equal current/prior values, the comparison neutral-flat color branch is unreachable because positive=true wins. A no-change state becomes success-colored independent of the metric's business direction.
sourceConfirmedFindings.sourceRepro: Follow equal current and previous operands through trendFor into DigestTrend's non-highlight class conditional.
sourceConfirmedFindings.proposedNarrowFix: Parent queue only neutral-flat precedence at the existing trend owner and focused equal/signed/inverted cases. Preserve direction, percent, accessibility description and non-flat favorability; visual contrast still needs native review.
